item.title: RESTAURANT DESTROYED BY FIRE
item.description: A fire destroyed Reyes Mexican Grill in Cleveland on Wednesday afternoon, Jan. 14.At approximately 3:15 p.m., the Cleveland Fire Department was dispatched to the restaurant at 810 N. Washington Ave. after heavy smoke was seen coming through the roofline, according to Fire Chief Sean Anderson. Firefighters made an interior attack but were forced back due to […]

item.title: Breaking – Fire Reignites at Cleveland Restaurant
item.description: 9 p.m. Montgomery County Firefighters are again providing mutual aid to City of Cleveland Fire Department at Reyes Mexican Grill at 810 N. Washington Avenue. The eatery was the scene of a large structure fire earlier and was extinguished, but has reportedly reignited.
